description: Ensure Ollama is installed and running on the remote and the chosen model is pulled.

steps.description: Install Ollama using the official script (only if not already installed).
Download the chosen model (skipped if already present).

uninstall.run: sudo systemctl disable --now ollama 2>/dev/null || pkill -f 'ollama serve' || true

uninstall.description: Remove downloaded models and data (can be several GB).
Uninstall the Ollama binary, service and user.
uninstall.run: sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/ollama /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service; sudo userdel ollama 2>/dev/null || true
